BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax exemption for amounts derived from animal adoption fees collected by a nonprofit.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a business and occupation tax exemption for amounts derived from animal adoption fees collected by a nonprofit; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and creating a new section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Beginning January 1, 2024, this chapter does not apply to amounts derived from animal adoption fees collected by a nonprofit as defined in RCW 84.36.800.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 82.32.805 and 82.32.808 do not apply to this act.
